## Kraidyl (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
Kraidyl warrior 1  
NE Medium humanoid (reptilian)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15(+4 armor, +1 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 13 (1d10+3)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +1, **Will** +0  
**Defensive Abilities** negative energy affinity; **Weaknesses** light blindness, vulnerability to positive energy  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** falchion +3 (2d4+3, Crit 18–20/x2) and bite +2 (1d6+1)  
**Ranged** javelin +2 (1d6+2, Range 30 ft.)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 1st; concentration +1)  

 1/day—hypnotism (DC 11)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** Kraidyl use Stealth to hide in their surroundings and catch enemies unaware.  

 **During Combat** Kraidyl charge at their enemies and savagely attack with instinctual fury.  

 **Morale** Kraidyl only retreat when reduced to 2 hp or less.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 15, **Dex** 12, **Con** 10, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 14  
**Feats** Toughness  
**Skills** Perception +4, Stealth +5  
**Languages** Undercommon  
**SQ** hold breath, stalker  

**Special Abilities**

 **Positive Energy Vulnerability (Ex)** Kraidyl have vulnerability to positive energy. When subjected to an attack that deals positive energy damage, a kraidyl takes half again as much damage (+50%) and if a save against the spell or effect is allowed, the kraidyl suffers a –4 penalty to the save.  

 **Negative Energy Affinity**: Kraidyl are alive but the profane energies coursing through their bodies make them react differently to negative and positive energy. Positive energy harms a kraidyl, while negative energy heals it.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or hunting pack (4–16)  
**Treasure** standard (falchion, hide armor, javelin [3])
